newsitem.title: DUBAI: British minister meets Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince.
newsitem.headline: British minister meets Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince.

text.p: Britain's minister for the armed forces Nicholas Soames met Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince Abdullah on Wednesday, the official Saudi news agency SPA said.
He handed the prince a letter from Prince Charles, heir to the British throne, it added. It gave no further details.
A spokesman for the British embassy said on Tuesday Soames arrived in the Saudi capital Riyadh on Monday as part of a private visit.
He was due to visit British forces in the Gulf Arab state before departing on Thursday, he said.
Soames previously held talks in Bahrain with the emir.
